links.outcome: Classification accuracy of CNN ARL versus simpler SVM baseline on same test data
links.effect: ARL achieved 99.2% overall accuracy on the test dataset versus 91.5% for the SVM baseline.
links.quote: ARL achieved an overall accuracy of 99.2% on the test dataset, outperforming the SVM (91.5% accuracy).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the feasibility and real-world deployment (prospectively for 22 consecutive days in a radiotherapy workflow) of a deep learning anatomical region labeling tool for CBCT scans, but focuses on validating model accuracy rather than comparing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
